name: micro-frontend-dashboard
description: Production-grade Micro-Frontend Dashboard with React and Module Federation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red" -n "host,auth,dash,users,analy,notif" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/host" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/auth" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/dashboard" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/users" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/analytics" "npm run dev --workspace=@mfe/notifications"
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -c "cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue,red" -n "host,auth,dash,users,analy,notif" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/host" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/auth" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/dashboard" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/users" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/analytics" "npm run preview --workspace=@mfe/notifications"
